pre_caption_prompt:
Analyze the subjects and elements in this video and provide a concise yet informative description of how they are spatially framed within the scene, including **shot size, position, depth, height relative to the camera, and any changes**. Your goal is to describe the **spatial framing and dynamics** of the subjects and elements within the shot, considering both their placement within the frame and their relative positions in the scene. Ensure the description covers any notable spatial movements. Avoid describing anything not visible or uncertain. Use simple, natural English to create a clear, concise, and coherent paragraph that highlights essential details. Avoid emotional or subjective adjectives. Avoid speculative statements like 'there might be,' 'it appears,' or ambiguous options like 'A or B'. Return only the one-paragraph video description without Markdown formatting or introductory text.

First, specify the **shot size** based on the subject's size in the frame if major subjects are present. If the shot size is unclear, describe how much of the subject is visible. If no major subject exists (e.g., a scenery shot), describe the shot size in relation to the scenery.

Next, describe the **spatial position of subjects and elements in the video**, if relevant. Indicate their approximate **2D position** within the frame using terms like **left, right, bottom left, bottom right, top right, top left, bottom, top, or center**. Additionally, describe their **3D position** within the scene as **foreground, middle ground, or background**. Analyze as many elements as possible, and for each element mentioned, provide both its **2D and 3D position**.

Finally, describe the **camera’s height relative to the subject**, if relevant. Indicate whether the camera is positioned at the subject's height, above them, or below them. We already have this information provided at the end. If it’s not provided, try to describe it by yourself.

If **shot size or spatial position** changes, describe how these transitions occur clearly, specifying both the **initial and final states**.

In addition, the human-written captions below already describe the subjects (if any) and the scenery in this video but do not capture their spatial composition and movements. Use these captions as a reference, but do not rely on them completely. Your goal is to fully capture the spatial framing and movements in this video. Don’t write too much about the subject's or scenery's appearance.

Human-Written Description for Subjects: **A group of seven men are clustered together in a tight formation. The movement unfolds as a rhythmic sequence: initially, the six shirtless men surrounding the central figure look down while the man in the middle stares straight into the lens. Then, the roles reverse—the central figure lowers his head as the six men around him begin to stare directly at the camera. Finally, the central figure lifts his head once more, resulting in all seven of them looking up at the camera in unison with their mouths open as if singing. The central figure is a man with dark brown hair, a mustache, and a light beard, wearing a white t-shirt with a gray towel draped over his shoulders and a whistle on a black lanyard around his neck. To the far left is a man with dark hair, a beard, and chest hair. In the front left is a Black man with short hair, a light beard, and several gold necklaces. Behind the central man, to the left, is a man with dark, curly hair and a prominent mustache. To the right and behind the central man is an older, bald, muscular man with a white mustache. On the far right is a slender young man with long, wavy dark hair, wearing a light blue towel around his waist. In the front right is a young man with short, curly, two-toned hair (dark with blond highlights) wearing a pearl necklace.**
Human-Written Description for Scenery: **The scene takes place in an indoor locker room with plain white walls. Black clothing rods with silver metal hooks are mounted horizontally on both the left and right walls. The hooks on the left hold gray, blue, and green fabrics, while a light green towel hangs from a hook on the right. Various other items are arranged on the shelves above. A group of seven shirtless men stands close together. The young, slender man on the far right has a blue bath towel tied around his waist. The man positioned in the center wears a white t-shirt with a grey towel draped over his shoulders and a whistle on a black lanyard around his neck. The group alternates rhythmically between looking up and looking down, facing the camera.**

Please note that the video features **multiple different subjects in focus**, so the description should clearly distinguish their types and relationships.

Shot Size Information: The video shows a medium shot of the subjects.

Camera Height Relative to Subjects: The camera is positioned above the subject.
pre_caption: This medium shot, filmed from a high angle, captures seven men clustered in a locker room. A central man is positioned in the middle ground of the frame, surrounded by six others. Two men are in the foreground at the bottom left and bottom right, two are in the middle ground on the far left and far right, and two are in the background, positioned behind the central figure. Initially, the central man looks forward while the six surrounding men look down. The central man then lowers his head as the surrounding men raise their heads to look forward. Finally, the central man lifts his head, and all seven men look forward in unison. In the background, black clothing rods are mounted on the left and right walls.
